_about: What the Growth app can already do on its own, one entry per ability. Add-ons are compared against this list when they are connected, so 'adds', 'strengthens' and 'can drop' are judged against facts. Hiding an entry (profile.modules.retired) is reversible; nothing here is ever deleted.

abilities.label: Review a task you handed in
say: look at my usability test task
abilities.where: growth-coach: critique checklists per kind of work

abilities.label: Read your CV and say what to change first
abilities.where: growth-coach: CV checklist and the one-page CV in growth/cv

abilities.label: Build, tailor, check and export your CV, every fact with a source
say: tailor my CV for this job
abilities.where: /growth cv build and the other cv commands; data/career.json

abilities.label: Read your portfolio and name the weakest case study
Work on a case study with you
say: work on the checkout case study
abilities.where: growth-coach: case study checklist; career-notes sections 3.9 and 3.10 apply

abilities.label: Run a mock interview, one question at a time
say: mock interview for a fintech role

abilities.label: Find and score things to read, watch and hear
abilities.where: growth-coach: Scoring picks before they are shown

abilities.label: A small checked thought from a designer
say: give me a thought from a designer

abilities.label: Read your journal and say what it shows
say: what does my journal show this week

abilities.label: Plan your week
Change your goal when it feels different
Change your pace or reorder your gaps
Read your LinkedIn profile text and say what to change first
abilities.where: growth-coach: LinkedIn checklist; /growth analyse linkedin without an add-on

abilities.label: Draft a short note to a person or company for you to send
say: draft a note to someone at a company

abilities.label: Say what is new in your field that matters to you
Test a skill with a short check
Quiz you on your own notes
Keep track of the jobs you applied for
A short learning brief on a topic
Answer a bad moment with your own evidence
